title: Home Comfort Financing Pull-Forward Relief by Account Age
content:
On Home Comfort Financing, the pull-forward account-age relief is 30 percent when the account funded at least 36 whole months before the date of handling, 20 percent when it funded at least 12 but fewer than 36 whole months before, and zero when it funded fewer than 12 whole months before.

| Whole months since funding | Pull-forward account-age relief |
|---|---|
| 36 and over | 30 percent |
| 12 through 35 | 20 percent |
| under 12 | zero |

The relief is one of the pull-forward reliefs. The pulled-forward share of the next installment — the monthly payment multiplied by the pull-forward share — is reduced once by the pull-forward reliefs added together, and the reliefs never act one after another.

## Boundary and worked cases (hypothetical accounts)

- Funded 11 whole months before: zero. Funded 12 whole months before: 20 percent.
- Funded 35 whole months before: 20 percent. Funded 36 whole months before: 30 percent.
- Monthly payment $410.00, pull-forward share 50 percent, account funded 20 whole months before, a further pull-forward relief of 25 percent also applying: the reliefs total 45 percent. Pulled-forward share: $410.00 multiplied by 50 and divided by 100 ($205.00), multiplied by 55 and divided by 100: $112.75.
